{{Top|leg}}
'''B'tan flyers''' were carnivorous [[Fish/Legends|fish]] native to [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] which attacked their prey by leaping out of the [[Water/Legends|water]]. It was theorized that [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino's]] [[spike-finned sounder]]s were descended from the escaped specimens used in [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] experiments by the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]].
